name: TOBAY Beach

evidence.note: Town announcement: car show moved to Sat Oct 3, 11 am-4 pm, free for spectators, live concert by That 70's Band.
News report: big crowd on Oct 3; That 70s Band played during the show.

dancing.notes: This is an outdoor car show with a free daytime concert. People mostly walk around and watch; we found no reports of dancing.

description: A Town of Oyster Bay beach on Ocean Parkway with ocean and bay sides, a marina and a spray park. On Oct 3 it hosts the free Car Show Long Island Fall Classic with a live band.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira listed an event, not a venue; we used TOBAY Beach (Town of Oyster Bay) as the venue. Event info line from the town: 516-797-4121; extra parking and a shuttle from Jones Beach Field 5. TOBAY Beach is normally limited to Town of Oyster Bay residents, with limited non-resident access. Kind could also be 'festival' for this event.
